text:
Tariq: Quick micro-poll — mug swap shelf in the kitchen? Leave a mug, take a mug. Low commitment, high personality. :mug:
Ava: 100% in. Can we add tiny labels with names or nicknames? :label:
Lina: I'll donate my questionable souvenir mug collection. Warning: one says "I <3 Reykjavik".
Diego: Count me in if theres a rule: only one mug with a motivational quote allowed. :raised_hands:
Tariq: Rule idea: each mug gets a 1-line origin story sticker. e.g., "Found at a gas station in 2012".
Ava: Love the origin story idea. Also theme weeks? This week: city mugs. Next week: plants. :seedling:
OpsBot: Facilities note: Please don't leave dirty mugs overnight. Dishwasher cycles are 9am and 4pm. :wastebasket:
Lina: tagging @Tariq — can we add a little cardboard tag kit by the shelf? I can bring one.
Diego: One-liners for the sticker kit: "Borrowed, not broken." "Handle with chill." "This mug contains optimism."
Ava: "Not a pen holder. Not a plan." :laughing:
Tariq: OK that's the vibe. Pop-up setup at 10:15 near the sink. Bring a mug if you want to swap. Also: someone volunteer to be the mug sheriff? :sheriff:
Lina: I'll be mug-sheriff for the inaugural shift. Promise to only mildly judge. :sunglasses:
Diego: Micro-kudos to Facilities for making the kitchen a tolerable chaos zone this week. :sparkles:
OpsBot: Coffee refill scheduled for 9:30. Reminder: label your own travel mugs if they have stickers that look like other people's. :coffee:
Ava: This escalated into tiny stickers and a coronation for a mug sheriff. Office life is beautiful. :blob_heart:
Tariq: See you at 10:15. New rule added: anyone who brings a novelty mug must tell the story in 15 seconds flat.
Diego: "I bought it on a dare while on a layover." :timer_clock:
